channel.title: Crypto Bulletin
channel.description: Crypto Bulletin reports crypto news on bitcoin, ethereum, stablecoins, exchanges, DeFi protocols, regulation, security incidents and market structure.

item.title: Chainalysis says breach exposed credentials and tokens for all users
item.description: Chainalysis says an attacker exposed names, usernames, password hashes and live tokens for all users, prompting account resets and service shutdowns.

item.title: Zcash Activates NU7, Cutting Target Block Time to 25 Seconds
item.description: Zcash activated NU7 at block 3,543,405, cutting target block intervals to 25 seconds and expanding shielded payment capacity while routing fees to future mining rewards.

item.title: Binance says fake job interview preceded $6.34B hack
item.description: Binance says a fake recruitment process helped attackers breach its wallet systems and steal $6.34 billion, prompting the exchange to replenish user assets.

item.title: FBI links $6 billion Binance theft to North Korea
item.description: The FBI says North Korea-linked TraderTraitor stole more than $6 billion from Binance on Oct. 29 and is converting assets into Ether ahead of laundering attempts.

item.title: TeleSwap’s Bitcoin bridge trades custody control for verification
item.description: TeleSwap verifies Bitcoin deposits on-chain, but wraps take 40–60 minutes and add locker and network fees, after reported $735,000 outflows.

item.title: Hong Kong passes crypto tax reporting law
item.description: Hong Kong passed a law requiring crypto service providers to collect customer and transaction data from 2027, with tax information exchanges starting in 2028.

item.title: Binance says fake job interview preceded $6.34bn hack
item.description: Binance says a fake recruiter lured an engineer into downloading malware before attackers stole $6.34 billion in digital assets through compromised wallet systems.

item.title: Binance puts security incident impact at about $6.3 billion
item.description: Binance said a security incident may have enabled unauthorized withdrawals worth about $6.3 billion, with roughly $3 billion frozen as it investigates.

item.title: FBI blames North Korea for $6bn Binance crypto theft
item.description: The FBI says North Korean hackers stole more than $6 billion from Binance on Oct. 29, drawing new scrutiny to the security of crypto’s largest exchange.

item.title: OCC finalizes GENIUS Act rules for payment stablecoins
item.description: The OCC’s GENIUS Act rule sets reserve, redemption and supervision standards for covered stablecoin issuers, effective on Jan. 18, 2027.

item.title: Binance begins phased withdrawals after $6.3B hack
item.description: Binance began phased withdrawals on Sunday after suspending them over a hack that stole more than $6 billion from its wallets, while security checks continue.

item.title: Binance says it has covered 90% of $6.3B hack losses
item.description: Binance says it has covered 90% of losses from a $6.3 billion security incident, with the remaining assets still being sourced and withdrawals due Sunday.

item.title: Solana Alpenglow targets 150ms transaction finality
item.description: Solana activated Alpenglow on Oct. 21, replacing its 2020-era consensus with a 150-millisecond finality target that could speed payment settlement.

item.title: How to Compare Near-Peg Swap Prices
item.description: Compare near-peg swap quotes by checking the execution price, fees, route and slippage at the amount you plan to trade—not the displayed token rate.

item.title: Binance says hot-wallet hack cost $6.3 billion
item.description: Binance says hackers stole about $6.3 billion from its hot wallets on Oct. 29, with roughly $3 billion frozen as the exchange pledges to cover losses.

item.title: TRM links $6.36B Binance hack to North Korea’s TraderTraitor
item.description: TRM and Chainalysis linked Binance’s Oct. 29 theft of about $6.36 billion to North Korea’s TraderTraitor group; Binance says it froze roughly $3 billion.

item.title: Binance estimates security incident impact at $6.3 billion
item.description: Binance estimates a security incident affected about $6.3 billion, says roughly $3 billion is frozen and deposits and withdrawals remain suspended during checks.

item.title: Ripple wins final OCC approval for national trust bank
item.description: Ripple received final OCC approval for a national trust bank on Oct. 26, adding federal oversight to RLUSD reserves and custody while issuance stays with its New York entity.

item.title: Dogecoin Labs brings MyDoge, DogeOS and Such App together
item.description: Dogecoin Labs formed with the Dogecoin Foundation, combining MyDoge, DogeOS and Such App to build wallet, application and merchant payment tools around DOGE.

item.title: JPMorgan brings JPM Coin deposit token to Ethereum
item.description: JPMorgan’s JPM Coin is now available to institutional clients on Ethereum, extending the bank’s dollar deposit token beyond Base for onchain transfers.
